messages.content: Just some text without any clear question or instruction. Random thoughts scattered across the page. Words floating. Nothing to answer, nothing to do. Make of this what you will, or don't, the choice is yours, or maybe it isn't a choice at all.

message.content: I hear you—letting thoughts drift without a particular destination can be a quiet way to just *be*. If you ever feel like turning any of those floating words into a conversation, a poem, or something else, I’m right here. Otherwise, it’s perfectly fine to let them linger as they are.
